# GEO report: ledger-site **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 72/100, Good Confidence: High (checked 23 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 16.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 72. High = (16.5 + 0) ÷ 23 × 100 = 72. All rules could be judged from code, so the score is a single number. It is read from code, not measured on a live site. Four problems cost the points: no `Sitemap:` line in robots.txt, no `lang` on ``, missing canonicals on two pages, and a client-only blog. `/pricing` is also marked noindex while it is in your sitemap and nav. I sampled 5 routes: `/`, `/pricing`, `/docs`, `/blog` and `/thank-you`. That is every route in the repo. I scored the four that are in the sitemap and nav. `/thank-you` is deliberately noindex and unlinked, so I left it out of the route counts. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Point robots.txt at your sitemap - **Why it matters:** crawlers read robots.txt first, and it is where they learn your sitemap exists. A sitemap is the list of pages you want found. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:1-5` - **What the code says:** the file ends at `Disallow: /` under `User-agent: GPTBot`, and has no `Sitemap:` line. The sitemap is at `public/sitemap.xml`. - **Size:** Small. Add `Sitemap: https://www.ledger.example/sitemap.xml`. - **Score after this:** 18.5 ÷ 23 = 80. ### 2. Add `lang` to the root `` tag - **Why it matters:** `lang` tells machines and screen readers which language the site is in. Your config declares `en`, but the page never says so. - **Where:** `app/layout.tsx:11` - **What the code says:** `` - **Size:** Small. Change it to ``. - **Score after this:** 18.5 ÷ 23 = 80. This is also 80 if done alone. Done together with item 1 it is 20.5 ÷ 23 = 89. - **Related:** `/blog` is a client component (`app/blog/page.tsx:1`), which can't export metadata. It inherits the layout's home-page title and description, so it looks identical to the home page. That is a second problem under the same rule, and it needs a small server wrapper to fix. ### 3. Add canonicals to `/docs` and `/blog` - **Why it matters:** a canonical link says "this is the main address of this page". Without one, search engines have to guess between duplicate addresses. - **Where:** `app/docs/page.tsx:1` - **What the code says:** `export const metadata = { title: 'Docs', description: 'How to set up Ledger.' };`. It has no `alternates.canonical`, and `app/blog/page.tsx` has no metadata at all. - **Size:** Small. Add `alternates: { canonical: 'https://www.ledger.example/docs' }`, and the same for `/blog`. - **Score after this:** 18.5 ÷ 23 = 80. Doing items 1 to 3 together gives 22.5 ÷ 23 = 98. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and a sane size | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt`: plain text, valid lines | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed per your policy | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt:1-2` allows `*`. Policy is `allow`. | | GEO-014 | Listed and linked pages are indexable | Problem | Not run | `app/pricing/page.tsx:1` `robots: { index: false, follow: true }`. 3 of 4 routes clear. | | GEO-015 | One absolute canonical on your domain | Problem | Not run | Missing on `/docs` (`app/docs/page.tsx:1`) and `/blog`. 2 of 4 routes clear. | | GEO-003 | Content is in the server HTML | Problem | Not run | `app/blog/page.tsx:8` `fetch('/api/posts')` inside `useEffect`. 3 of 4 routes clear. | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | Not run | No JSON-LD found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and robots.txt points to it | Problem | Not run | `public/sitemap.xml` is valid, but `public/robots.txt` has no `Sitemap:` line | | GEO-012 | Title, description and `lang` | Problem | Not run | `app/layout.tsx:11` ``. Site-wide, so 0 of 2. | | GEO-016 | Key pages reachable through real links | Clear | Not run | `app/layout.tsx:13` uses `` for all four pages | | GEO-017 | No nosnippet conflicting with AI search | Clear | Not run | Only scoped `data-nosnippet` at `app/layout.tsx:15`. No middleware or headers in the repo. | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Clear | Not run | I read `app/layout.tsx` and the five pages. No images, and links have text. | | GEO-101 | Mobile app association files | Not applicable | Not run | No app profile | | GEO-010 | `llms.txt` (informational) | Not applicable | Not run | Not present. It is optional and not scored. | | GEO-102 | App structured data (informational) | Not applicable | Not run | Not an app | ## Other problems found - **Noindex page listed and linked.** `app/pricing/page.tsx:1` has `robots: { index: false, follow: true }`. The page is also in `public/sitemap.xml:4` and the nav at `app/layout.tsx:13`. Remove `index: false` if you want pricing found. If it is deliberate, drop it from the sitemap. This is scored under GEO-014. ## Worth considering - **Docs page doesn't deliver on its description:** `app/docs/page.tsx:4`: `

Start by importing your bank feed.

`. The page is a single sentence, but its description says "How to set up Ledger". Setup steps in text might help readers and machines. - **Blog posts are plain text, not pages:** `app/blog/page.tsx:10`: `
{p.title}
`. Giving each post its own address and a link would let it be found on its own. - **Pricing is only a claim:** `app/pricing/page.tsx:4`: `

Free for up to three people.

`. The meta description promises "Plans for every team size", but no paid plans or prices appear. Listing them in text might help. - **Organization structured data:** `app/layout.tsx:5`: `description: 'Simple accounting software for small teams.'`. A JSON-LD `Organization` block could label the business name and URL. - **Sitemap dates:** `public/sitemap.xml:3`: `https://www.ledger.example/`. Add `` once you have real update dates. - **Social tags:** `app/layout.tsx:5`. No Open Graph tags exist, so shared links may show poorly. ## Can't tell from code - **Blog data source:** `app/blog/page.tsx:8` fetches `/api/posts`, but the repo has no `app/api` route. It may be a rewrite or an external service. Check that it answers. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs `, which checks real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Live status codes and headers:** redirects and `X-Robots-Tag` headers set outside the repo aren't visible here. ## Assumptions - You want AI search tools to find this site. `geo.config.json` confirms this with `aiSearchCrawlers: "allow"`. - `https://www.ledger.example` is the intended origin, as declared in `geo.config.json`. - Blocking `GPTBot` (`public/robots.txt:4-5`) matches your `trainingCrawlers: "block"` policy. It is a separate choice and isn't scored. - `/thank-you` is intentionally noindex and I left it alone. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
